nodes.text:
So evidently China has announced today from “Source: China News Service, National Emergency Broadcasting, Hubei News, China Center for Disease Control and Prevention, CCTV Finance”.   Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) is rising at a considerable rate, young kids, older adults, and patients with immune deficiency are at risk. 

In the newspaper in China, 12/26/2024 at 4:33 pm China time.
